title: 🔥 THE GIFT OF TONGUES: IS IT LEARNED OR GIVEN BY GOD?
paragraphs:
🔥 THE GIFT OF TONGUES: IS IT LEARNED OR GIVEN BY GOD?
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I have heard that some churches teach people to practice speaking in tongues until they develop it. But I also heard that tongues are a supernatural gift from God. Can I learn tongues, or does it have to be given by the Holy Spirit?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many believers today are confused about the gift of tongues because of contradictory teachings. Some churches claim that everyone must speak in tongues to prove they have the Holy Spirit, while others try to teach people how to "practice" speaking in tongues. But what does the Bible really say?

📖 1 Corinthians 12:11 (KJV)
"But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will."
🚨 THE TRUTH: THE GIFT OF TONGUES IS GIVEN, NOT LEARNED!

✔️ The gift of tongues is a supernatural ability, not a learned skill.
✔️ It is one of the gifts of the Holy Spirit, and not everyone receives it.
✔️ Nowhere in the Bible does it say we must practice or fake tongues to receive it.
✔️ God gives spiritual gifts according to His will, not human effort!
🔥 DOES THE HOLY SPIRIT GIVE GIFTS, OR DO WE DEVELOP THEM OURSELVES?
💡 QUESTION: Are you seeking the real gift of tongues from God, or are you trying to "train" yourself to do it?
WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY ABOUT THE GIFT OF TONGUES?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, where does the Bible talk about tongues, and how do we know it is a real gift from God?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people today misunderstand the gift of tongues because they have been taught human traditions instead of biblical truth. Some think tongues are just a personal prayer language, while others believe it must be a real human language. But what does the Bible actually teach?

📖 Acts 2:4 (KJV)
"And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance."
🚨 BIBLICAL FACTS ABOUT THE GIFT OF TONGUES!

✔️ 1️⃣ TONGUES IS A SPIRITUAL GIFT, NOT A LEARNED SKILL!
📖 1 Corinthians 12:7-10 (KJV) – "But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal… To another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues."
💡 Lesson: It is the Holy Spirit who gives the gift of tongues—it cannot be taught!

✔️ 2️⃣ NOT EVERY CHRISTIAN WILL RECEIVE THE GIFT OF TONGUES!
📖 1 Corinthians 12:30 (KJV) – "Have all the gifts of healing? Do all speak with tongues? Do all interpret?"
💡 Lesson: Paul makes it clear that not every believer will have this gift! It is not a requirement for salvation.

✔️ 3️⃣ BIBLICAL TONGUES WERE REAL LANGUAGES!
📖 Acts 2:6 (KJV) – "Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language."
💡 Lesson: The first instance of tongues in the Bible was not gibberish—it was actual languages understood by others!

✔️ 4️⃣ TONGUES MUST BE INTERPRETED IN PUBLIC WORSHIP!
📖 1 Corinthians 14:27-28 (KJV) – "If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret. But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church."
💡 Lesson: If tongues are spoken in a church setting, there must be an interpreter, or it should not be spoken publicly!
🔥 BIBLICAL TONGUES IS NOT JUST RANDOM BABBLING—IT HAS A PURPOSE!

📖 1 Corinthians 14:22 (KJV)
"Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ Speaking in tongues is a spiritual gift—not a requirement for salvation!
✔️ Biblical tongues must be understood by others or interpreted in church!
✔️ The Holy Spirit, not man, decides who receives this gift!
🔥 ARE YOU SEEKING THE TRUE GIFT OF TONGUES, OR HAVE YOU BEEN MISLED BY MAN-MADE TEACHINGS?
💡 QUESTION: Are you open to receiving the true gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to the Bible?
SHOULD CHRISTIANS "PRACTICE" TONGUES, OR DOES GOD GIVE IT FREELY?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, some churches say you must practice speaking in tongues until you 'activate' it. Is this biblical, or does God give it supernaturally?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many believers have been taught that they need to "train" themselves to speak in tongues by repeating syllables or making sounds until it becomes fluent. However, nowhere in Scripture does the Bible say we must "practice" tongues. The gift of tongues is always described as something that comes directly from the Holy Spirit!

📖 Acts 2:4 (KJV)
"And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance."
🚨 BIBLICAL TRUTH – YOU CANNOT LEARN A SPIRITUAL GIFT!

✔️ 1️⃣ THE HOLY SPIRIT GIVES THE GIFT SOVEREIGNLY!
📖 1 Corinthians 12:11 (KJV) – "But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will."
💡 Lesson: The Holy Spirit alone decides who receives the gift of tongues. It cannot be forced or learned!

✔️ 2️⃣ NOWHERE IN SCRIPTURE DOES ANYONE "PRACTICE" TONGUES!
📖 Acts 10:44-46 (KJV) – "While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word… for they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God."
💡 Lesson: In every biblical instance, tongues happened instantly by the power of the Holy Spirit—never by human effort!

✔️ 3️⃣ FALSE TEACHERS TRY TO TEACH PEOPLE TO "FAKE" TONGUES!
📖 Matthew 6:7 (KJV) – "But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do."
💡 Lesson: God never instructs us to repeat meaningless syllables to "activate" a spiritual gift!

✔️ 4️⃣ FAKE TONGUES CAN BE DANGEROUS!
📖 1 John 4:1 (KJV) – "Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world."
💡 Lesson: Not every supernatural experience is from God—Satan can counterfeit signs and wonders!
🔥 BIBLICAL TONGUES ARE A GIFT—NOT A SKILL TO BE LEARNED!

📖 James 1:17 (KJV)
"Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ You don’t need to "practice" tongues—if God wants to give it to you, He will!
✔️ Avoid churches that pressure people to fake tongues—this is not biblical!
✔️ Instead of seeking tongues, seek GOD—and let Him decide what gifts to give you!
🔥 ARE YOU SEEKING THE HOLY SPIRIT'S GIFTS BIBLICALLY, OR HAVE YOU BEEN TAUGHT A FALSE METHOD?
💡 QUESTION: Will you trust God to give His gifts in His time, or will you try to force a spiritual experience?
WHAT IS THE TRUE PURPOSE OF TONGUES?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if tongues are not something we practice, then why did God give this gift? What is the biblical purpose of tongues?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many believers have been misled into thinking that tongues are just for personal prayer or proof of salvation. However, the Bible gives clear reasons why God gave this gift!

📖 1 Corinthians 14:22 (KJV)
"Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not."
🚨 THE THREE BIBLICAL PURPOSES OF TONGUES!

✔️ 1️⃣ A SIGN TO UNBELIEVERS!
📖 Acts 2:6-8 (KJV) – "Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language."
💡 Lesson: Tongues were first given at Pentecost to confirm God’s power to unbelievers!

✔️ 2️⃣ A GIFT TO BUILD UP THE CHURCH!
📖 1 Corinthians 14:5 (KJV) – "I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying."
💡 Lesson: Tongues must be interpreted in church, or it does not help anyone!

✔️ 3️⃣ A WAY TO PRAY IN THE SPIRIT—BUT NOT REQUIRED FOR EVERYONE!
📖 1 Corinthians 14:14 (KJV) – "For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful."
💡 Lesson: Paul says praying in tongues is useful but should not be forced on everyone!
🔥 BIBLICAL TONGUES WERE NEVER ABOUT SHOWING OFF OR PROVING SALVATION!

📖 Matthew 7:22-23 (KJV)
"Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not… in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ Tongues are a sign to unbelievers, not a proof of salvation!
✔️ Tongues in church must be interpreted to benefit others!
✔️ Praying in tongues is biblical but is not required for every believer!
🔥 ARE YOU USING THE GIFT OF TONGUES BIBLICALLY, OR HAVE YOU BEEN TAUGHT A DIFFERENT GOSPEL?
💡 QUESTION: Are you seeking God’s truth, or are you following what man teaches?
SHOULD WE EXPECT TONGUES IN EVERY CHURCH TODAY?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, some say that every believer must speak in tongues, or they don’t have the Holy Spirit. Others say tongues have ceased. What is the biblical truth?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many churches today either force tongues on people or reject them entirely. But what does the Bible actually say?

📖 1 Corinthians 12:29-30 (KJV)
"Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles? Have all the gifts of healing? Do all speak with tongues? Do all interpret?"
🚨 THE TRUTH: NOT EVERY CHRISTIAN WILL SPEAK IN TONGUES!

✔️ 1️⃣ THE HOLY SPIRIT GIVES DIFFERENT GIFTS TO DIFFERENT PEOPLE!
📖 1 Corinthians 12:4-6 (KJV) – "Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit… but it is the same God which worketh all in all."
💡 Lesson: Tongues are just ONE of many gifts—not a requirement for salvation!

✔️ 2️⃣ THE BIBLE NEVER SAYS TONGUES WILL BE GIVEN TO EVERY BELIEVER!
📖 1 Corinthians 14:19 (KJV) – "Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding… than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue."
💡 Lesson: Even Paul, who spoke in tongues, said it was not the most important gift!

✔️ 3️⃣ TONGUES WERE NEVER THE PRIMARY SIGN OF THE HOLY SPIRIT!
📖 Acts 4:31 (KJV) – "And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness."
💡 Lesson: The true sign of the Holy Spirit is a transformed life, boldness, and obedience—not tongues!

✔️ 4️⃣ SOME BELIEVE TONGUES HAVE CEASED—BUT IS THAT BIBLICAL?
📖 1 Corinthians 13:8 (KJV) – "Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease."
💡 Lesson: Paul said tongues would cease, but he never said when. Until Christ returns, we must stay biblical and not add human opinions!
🔥 TONGUES ARE NOT FORCED ON EVERY BELIEVER, AND THEY HAVE A SPECIFIC PURPOSE IN THE CHURCH!

📖 2 Timothy 3:16 (KJV)
"All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ You do NOT need to speak in tongues to prove you have the Holy Spirit!
✔️ Churches should not force tongues, nor should they forbid them!
✔️ Focus on seeking God, not chasing gifts—He will give what is best for you!
🔥 ARE YOU SEEKING TONGUES BECAUSE OF PRESSURE, OR ARE YOU TRULY SEEKING GOD?
💡 QUESTION: Are you willing to follow what the Bible says about tongues, even if it goes against what you've been taught?
FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU TRUST GOD’S GIFTS OR FOLLOW MAN-MADE TRADITIONS?

💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you understand the truth about the gift of tongues, the question is: Will you follow what the Bible teaches, or will you believe man-made traditions?

📖 Mark 7:7-8 (KJV)
"Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men. For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men."
🚨 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

✔️ Will you trust that God gives spiritual gifts according to His will?
✔️ Will you stop chasing experiences and seek GOD instead of gifts?
✔️ Will you reject false teachings that force or fake tongues?
🔥 THE DEVIL WANTS YOU TO FOLLOW MAN-MADE TRADITIONS—BUT GOD CALLS YOU TO HIS TRUTH!

📖 John 8:32 (KJV)
"And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
💡 QUESTION: Will you stand on God’s Word or follow what men have taught you?

🚨 CHOOSE NOW:
❌ Believe false teachings that say you must "learn" tongues.
✔️ Trust God to give gifts according to His perfect will!
🔥 THE TIME FOR CONFUSION IS OVER—IT’S TIME TO SEEK GOD’S TRUTH!

Open my eyes to Your Word, and help me discern the true gifts of the Holy Spirit from man-made deceptions. I surrender to You, Lord—whatever gifts You choose to give me, I receive them with joy and humility. Let me walk in truth and never be deceived. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
PROOF, SOURCES & BIBLICAL EVIDENCE – THE TRUTH ABOUT TONGUES!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, is there solid biblical proof that tongues are a gift given by God and not something we can practice? Can we verify that tongues are not required for salvation?"
🚨 THE TRUTH: EVERYTHING WE TEACH IS ROOTED IN SCRIPTURE & VERIFIED BY HISTORY!

📖 2 Timothy 3:16-17 (KJV)
"All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works."

✅ BIBLICAL PROOF – TONGUES ARE GIVEN BY GOD, NOT LEARNED!
📖 THE HOLY SPIRIT DECIDES WHO RECEIVES THIS GIFT!
✔️ 1 Corinthians 12:11 (KJV) – "But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will."
💡 Lesson: It is the Holy Spirit who gives the gift of tongues—it is NOT something we can "activate" through human effort!

📖 NOT EVERY BELIEVER WILL RECEIVE THE GIFT OF TONGUES!
✔️ 1 Corinthians 12:30 (KJV) – "Have all the gifts of healing? Do all speak with tongues? Do all interpret?"
💡 Lesson: Paul makes it clear that tongues are not for every Christian. It is a gift, not a requirement!

📖 THE FIRST TONGUES WERE REAL HUMAN LANGUAGES!
✔️ Acts 2:6-8 (KJV) – "Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language."
💡 Lesson: Biblical tongues were understandable languages, not random sounds or meaningless babbling!

📖 TONGUES IN CHURCH MUST BE INTERPRETED!
✔️ 1 Corinthians 14:27-28 (KJV) – "If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret. But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church."
💡 Lesson: Speaking in tongues during a church service must follow order and must be interpreted, or it should not be spoken at all!

✅ HISTORICAL PROOF – EARLY CHURCH FATHERS CONFIRMED THE PURPOSE OF TONGUES!
📜 Augustine (354–430 AD) – "The gift of tongues was given as a sign for the unbelievers, not as a requirement for the faithful."
📜 John Chrysostom (347–407 AD) – "The miraculous tongues were spoken in the early church for a specific purpose, but we should not think that every believer must experience them."
📜 Martin Luther (1483–1546 AD) – "Signs and wonders confirmed the message of the apostles, but salvation is by faith alone, not by outward signs."

💡 QUESTION: Will you follow the Bible’s teaching on tongues, or will you believe man-made traditions?
